findings: Non-blocking: the live-form column-aligned footer (WorksheetForm.tsx) is rendered as a standalone <table tableLayout:fixed> separate from the data table, so its even-split column widths will not pixel-match the data table's column widths. Cell count and order are correct, so values land in the correct logical compound column; only visual width alignment can drift. Could be tightened later by appending a real <tfoot> to the data table or sharing explicit column widths. Confirm during the manual UI review.
